diagnosis.root_cause: The controller_server process died at approximately 18.5 seconds with exit code -9, causing it to stop sending velocity commands to the robot's actuators. This led to immediate failures of all subsequent navigation goals (pickup P2, drop P1, pickup P3) as the robot received no motion commands.
evidence: controller_server process died at about 18.5 s (exit code -9)
All subsequent navigation goals failed after less than 0.2 seconds
